rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something that can cause death or is lethal.

example.english: This kind of venom may be deadly if it touches your skin.
example.traditional: 呢種毒液掂到皮膚就可能致命。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 duk6 jik6 dim3 dou2 pei4 fu1 zau6 ho2 nang4 zi3 meng6

rows.note: Use this colloquial intensifying phrase when something is extremely boring rather than physically dangerous.

example.english: This movie was deadly boring; I fell asleep after half an hour.
example.traditional: 呢套戲悶到死，我睇咗半個鐘就瞓着喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 mun6 dou3 sei2 ngo5 tai2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 zau6 fan3 zoek6 laa3
